/usr/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import csv,json,re
stop=set('''which will the a an and or of in to by for with on after before from into during as be have has had is are was were this that its his her their who what where when how at it s united states country countries city state official confirmed public first next new about against between through over under more most less not no would could should may might than then while been being one two three four five six seven eight nine ten april march june july 2026 2025 2024 question resolve resolved resolution date source truth accepted answer format provide publicly say says said according amid following monday tuesday wednesday thursday friday saturday sunday government president minister prime officials forces group people match visit talks war iran israeli iranian israel us'''.split())
def toks(s):
    return [t for t in re.findall(r\"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9'\\-]*\", str(s or '').lower()) if len(t)>2 and t not in stop]
rows=[]
for r in csv.DictReader(open('market.csv', newline='')):
    qtok=set(toks((r.get('title') or '')+' '+(r.get('background') or '')[:400]))
    if qtok: rows.append((r,qtok))
arts=[]
for i,line in enumerate(open('articles/2026/03/31/articles.jsonl')):
    a=json.loads(line)
    text=(a.get('title','')+' '+(a.get('content') or '')[:2600])
    arts.append((i,a,set(toks(text)),set(toks(a.get('title','')))))
results=[]
for r,qtok in rows:
    best=[]
    for i,a,atok,ttok in arts:
        inter=qtok&atok
        if not inter: continue
        score=len(inter)+2*len(qtok&ttok)
        if score>=3:
            best.append((score,sorted(inter)[:12],a))
    if best:
        best.sort(reverse=True,key=lambda x:x[0])
        results.append((best[0][0],r,best[:3]))
results.sort(reverse=True,key=lambda x:x[0])
for score,r,best in results[:80]:
    print('\\nQ',r['qid'],'score',score,'res',r['resolution_date'],'pred_date',r['my_prediction_date'])
    print(r['title'])
    print('pred',r['my_prediction'][:180])
    for sc,inter,a in best:
        print('  -',sc,a.get('date_publish'),a.get('title'))
        print('    terms',', '.join(inter))
